newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Mercosur exemptions to last 120 day - Malan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Mercosur exemptions to last 120 day - Malan.

text.p: Brazil Finance Minister Pedro Malan said that a partial exemption from new import financing rules for Mercosur countries will extend for an initial 120 days.
Speaking at a news conference Malan also said that Brazil would discuss the exemptions separately with Mercosur free trade associates Chile and Bolivia.
"For this period (120 days) we will continue discussing with our Mercosur partners," Malan said.
Asked whether the exemptions applied to Chile and Bolivia, Malan said, "We will talk to them."
Malan said that the four Mercosur partners would set up a sub-group on macroeconomic coordination to improve the lines of communication between member countries.

Malan was speaking at a news conference also attended by Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, called after the two countries clashed publicly over new Brazilian restrictions on import financing which were announced last week.
